V2.1_PV_M1_TRANSPLANT.established: no single block among v, u and the PV-incoming synaptic state switches the PV fate under a matched base and future stream
V2.1_PV_M1_TRANSPLANT.fail_boundary: the single-block hypothesis; controls reproduced exactly and every transplant was verified bitwise

V2.1_PV_M2_PAIR_TRANSPLANT.established: the intrinsic pair (v, u) is jointly sufficient to switch the PV fate while neither member is sufficient alone; the PV-incoming synaptic state is not required

PV_INTRINSIC_VU_PAIR_SUFFICIENT.claim: transplanting the donor v and u pair into the low-PV base state is sufficient to recover the active-PV fate under the matched future stochastic stream (A_vu 15.055 Hz against a donor control of 15.110 Hz); neither v nor u alone is sufficient (A_v 0.303 Hz, A_u 0.107 Hz, base 0.707 Hz)
PV_INTRINSIC_VU_PAIR_SUFFICIENT.not_established: necessity and mechanism. The converse transplant was not run, and sufficiency of a joint configuration is not a mechanism

WHOLE_SYSTEM_PROPAGATION.claim: the causal estimator R_A(g) = [r_on(g) - r_off(g)] - [r_on(0) - r_off(0)] returns exactly 0.000000 in all six areas at g = 0.5, and its held-out null floor is also exactly 0.0 and degenerate. The ON minus OFF difference is exactly zero at V1_1 too, which the retina drives directly, so the observable has no sensitivity at the point of injection
WHOLE_SYSTEM_PROPAGATION.established: the observable, not the contrast, is the defect. The observable is a 1 s window mean of rate_hz, which equals spikes per E cell per second, and across all 36 area-cells the baseline plus stimulus total is exactly 21.000000. The 1 s count is quantized by the 190 ms burst cycle and invariant to the stimulus, which moves timing and not count
WHOLE_SYSTEM_PROPAGATION.not_established: whether the hierarchy transmits. Propagation at g = 0.5 is neither confirmed nor denied. A zero-threshold presence diagnostic shows the ON and OFF runs differ only inside V1_1 at g = 0 and in every area at g = 0.5, but no magnitude, latency or verdict is claimed from it
WHOLE_SYSTEM_PROPAGATION.fail_boundary: this lineage's own acceptance. The adversarial null is UNMET because a degenerate floor licenses no tolerance

WHOLE_SYSTEM_PROPAGATION_HISTORICAL.claim: the propagation field of all eight earlier whole-system results is NON_IDENTIFYING. Its recorded numbers are correct as measurements of what they measured and are NOT rewritten, and no verdict is retracted; what changes is what may be concluded from them
WHOLE_SYSTEM_PROPAGATION_HISTORICAL.established: the field measures how a conserved 21 spikes per E cell splits across a window boundary in a 190 ms burst cycle, which is why it took the same values in areas no signal could reach
WHOLE_SYSTEM_PROPAGATION_HISTORICAL.authority: reviewer 2026-09-19: add a qualification, do not alter historical result numbers

WHOLE_SYSTEM_PERIODIC_MODE.claim: the periodic mode of a disconnected cortical object does not require local E->E recurrence. Zeroing all 113436 within-area E->E weights leaves a mode present in all six areas at 94 to 95 ms against an intact 94 to 95 ms, a change of at most 1 percent against a 10 percent tolerance fixed before execution, and far above each area's own Poisson null of about 0.10
WHOLE_SYSTEM_PERIODIC_MODE.established: local E->E recurrence is not necessary for the mode, at g = 0. Of the candidates WS-AUTH-2 left, intrinsic single-cell dynamics and the local E-I loop remain; the E-I loop was excluded from this intervention by the reviewer and was not ablated
WHOLE_SYSTEM_PERIODIC_MODE.not_established: what the coupled system does. Both arms ran fully disconnected, which the spec declared before execution. Also unestablished is which of the remaining candidates generates the mode

WHOLE_SYSTEM_BURST_STRUCTURE.claim: the burst structure does not survive the cut even though the mode does. Peak autocorrelation falls to 0.64 to 0.74 of its intact value in every area, and the final raster changes from discrete synchronous bursts reaching about 100 Hz with near silence between them to a smooth 3 to 30 Hz rate wave at the same period. The whole-system synchrony gate agrees independently: the intact arm fails it at V4_2 with CV 3.0129 against a 3.0 threshold and the cut arm passes
WHOLE_SYSTEM_BURST_STRUCTURE.not_established: anything quantitative about burst discreteness. The predeclared rule scores presence and period only. Adopting an observable for this after seeing the result would be retuning, so none is adopted and no verdict is claimed
WHOLE_SYSTEM_BURST_STRUCTURE.authority: recorded by the Actor as an observation outside the predeclared rule

WHOLE_SYSTEM_PERIOD_MEASURED.claim: the pooled E burst period is 94.0 ms, 10.6383 Hz, peak autocorrelation 0.885737 against a Poisson null threshold of 0.105559, measured by jomission.harness.oscillation over the final 1000 ms of the intact arm
WHOLE_SYSTEM_PERIOD_MEASURED.established: this is the first period figure in the project with a receipt. The 190 ms quoted in earlier prose has none: results/whole_system_authority_g000.json carries no period, frequency or autocorrelation field and no module computed one. No historical number is altered and no verdict is retracted
WHOLE_SYSTEM_PERIOD_MEASURED.not_established: what the earlier 190 ms figure was computed from. It is about twice 94 and its quoted 0.895 is close to this run's 0.886, which reading the second autocorrelation peak would produce, but that is a consistent explanation and not a measurement of the earlier run

WHOLE_SYSTEM_PERIOD_HISTORICAL.claim: the 190 ms burst period asserted by WS-DIAG-2, WS-AUTH-1 and WS-AUTH-2 is retired from active reasoning. The measured period of this architecture is 94 to 95 ms per area and 94.0 ms pooled. No historical result number is rewritten and no verdict is retracted; what changes is that 190 ms may no longer be used as an input to any argument, threshold, window or design choice
WHOLE_SYSTEM_PERIOD_HISTORICAL.established: the historical figure has a stated method and no preserved computation. WS-AUTH-1 records it as measured on the decimated 10 ms series over the final 3 s, but no result file carries a period, frequency or autocorrelation field and no module computed one, so the value cannot be recovered or rechecked. At 10 ms decimation a 94 ms peak sits at 9.4 samples, between bins, where the 19-sample harmonic at 190 ms can take the maximum. That is a consistent account of the discrepancy, not a measurement of those runs

WHOLE_SYSTEM_PERIOD_HISTORICAL.supersedes_for_active_use: WHOLE_SYSTEM_PERIOD_MEASURED, 94.0 ms pooled, 10.6383 Hz, peak autocorrelation 0.885737 against a Poisson null of 0.105559, measured by jomission.harness.oscillation over the final 1000 ms

WHOLE_SYSTEM_INTRINSIC_GENERATOR.claim: the 94 ms mode is generated by intrinsic single-cell dynamics. With every one of 246844 synapses set to 0.0, all 828 cortical E cells fire at a pooled interval of 94.1505 ms, and a single sliced cell at 94.5 ms, against the intact 94.0 ms
WHOLE_SYSTEM_INTRINSIC_GENERATOR.established: no circuit mechanism remains present and the period is unchanged. Inter-area coupling was exonerated by WS-AUTH-2, local E->E by SCI-WS-OSC-1, and the local E-I circuit is absent here
WHOLE_SYSTEM_INTRINSIC_GENERATOR.not_established: what the E-I circuit does. It was removed, not isolated. Also unestablished is behaviour at any tonic drive other than the frozen 5.0

E_RATE_AND_PERIOD_ARE_ONE_DOF.claim: E firing rate and the 94 ms period are a single degree of freedom. Interval CV 0.0141 is one spike per cycle, so 10.6213 Hz is the reciprocal of 94.1505 ms by construction, and the intact network E rate of 10.93 Hz is within about 3 percent
E_RATE_AND_PERIOD_ARE_ONE_DOF.consequence: any intervention that retargets E firing rate moves the period with it, and any intervention that retargets the period moves E rate. They cannot be set independently while E fires one spike per cycle
E_RATE_AND_PERIOD_ARE_ONE_DOF.not_established: whether a different regime, with several spikes per cycle, would decouple them

INTERNEURON_RATE_REGIME.claim: three of four cell classes are outside their B1 targets in the intact whole-system model. Whole-run means: E 10.93 Hz against a 5 to 8 target, PV 0.433 Hz against 12 to 25, SST 51.28 Hz against 6 to 12, VIP 0.446 Hz against 8 to 15. PV and VIP coverage within the broad plus or minus 50 percent band is 0.00, and so is SST's
INTERNEURON_RATE_REGIME.established: the E < PV ordering that jomission/qualification/b1_targets.py requires is violated by a factor of about 25, and V4_1.L4.SST at 81.5 Hz breaches the 80 Hz hard-FAIL line in manifests/agsdr_local_objectives.json constraint H10. The local E-I circuit that the causal tree lists as the remaining open candidate is therefore largely not operating: the only active inhibition is SST
INTERNEURON_RATE_REGIME.not_established: the cause. PV and VIP being 30 to 60 times below target is a construction or parameter defect, not a calibration offset, and nothing here diagnoses which. Measured from the 1 ms series decimated by 10, so these are subsampled means and should be re-measured at full resolution before any lineage depends on them
INTERNEURON_RATE_REGIME.authority: observed while scoping the reviewer's AGSDR calibration question, 2026-09-19. Recorded as a finding, not acted on
